usedFor: Docugami creates projects and Microsoft Excel lists them, as “Create Project” feeds “Add Row To Table”.

bestTemplate.name: “Create Project” in Docugami, then “Add Row To Table” in Microsoft Excel
bestTemplate.why: Each new project becomes a table row, so you can sort and total projects without opening Docugami.

watchOut: “Create Project” in Docugami is polling, so rows arrive after a scheduled check, not at once.
